name: ravel
description: A causal concurrency debugger for coding agents.

scripts.format: prettier --write packages apps integrations demo tests benchmarks/*.{ts,mjs} *.json *.yaml *.ts README.md docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md docs/DEMO.md docs/BENCHMARK.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages apps integrations demo tests benchmarks/*.{ts,mjs} *.json *.yaml *.ts README.md docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md docs/DEMO.md docs/BENCHMARK.md
scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --configLoader runner
